__NOTOC__
Display a source-authored notice that applies to one section.

== Usage ==
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">
{{Section notice|kind=version|text=Applies to this version.}}
</syntaxhighlight>

Omit optional parameters that do not apply. The parameter reference below lists supported names and aliases.

examples.description: A source-authored version scope for one section.
examples.invocation: {{Section notice|kind=version|text=This section applies only to versions 3.3.5 and later.}}

implementation.body_wikitext: {{#if:{{{text|}}}|{{{text}}}|Error: section notice text required}}

dom_assertions.text_contains: This section applies only to versions 3.3.5 and later.

render_fixtures.invocation: {{Section notice|kind=version|text=This section applies only to versions 3.3.5 and later.}}
